name: app-card
title: AppCard + AppCardElevation enum

public_api.constructor:
AppCard({
  required Widget child,
  VoidCallback? onTap,
  AppCardElevation elevation = AppCardElevation.sm,
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding,
  BorderRadius? radius,
})
public_api.enum: enum AppCardElevation { none, xs, sm, md, lg }

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Hover feedback: translateY(-2px) via AnimatedContainer when onTap provided (NOT scale)
Press feedback: scale 0.98 via AnimatedScale with disableAnimations guard
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: onTap makes card interactive (InkWell or GestureDetector)
completion_summary: Implemented AppCard with AppCardElevation enum, hover translateY(-2px), press scale 0.98, MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf guard
